factors.basis: The September 8 partnership is a new commercial distribution/integration channel for Nebius infrastructure and inference, expanding beyond direct cloud sales.

risks: Preferred-partner status is not equivalent to committed revenue and must not be valued as contracted backlog without disclosure.
unknowns: No committed contract value was disclosed for the Palantir partnership.

facts: Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner.
Following integration, Palantir plans to bring Nebius compute and inference endpoints inside its enterprise perimeter for eligible customers.

result: Materially new September primary-source commercial-channel evidence supplied to Alpha; economics remain unknown.
